advance_conditions.qualification_engineering: complete approach, external-trigger, contact and reporting checks; negative qualification stops dependent stages

advance_conditions.window_mechanism: qualified shared lower-skill bundle and validated full-task oracle
advance_conditions.outcome_data: measured active-preparation benefit; group-disjoint training/development/calibration parents
advance_conditions.closed_loop_development: frozen outcome models; evaluate selected-candidate error and real latency
advance_conditions.independent_comparison: freeze method and unseen test protocol before opening new TEST
advance_conditions.contingency: explicit separately identified attempts; no silently discarded costs
